The new plan introduces significant methodological changes, including the use of Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage, a shift from simple OLS-FMP to a comparison between OLS-FMP and characteristic-sorted portfolios, and a different approach to statistical validation (bootstrap vs. simple t-stats). The data processing and analysis steps are fundamentally different in their objectives and implementation, requiring a restart from the beginning.
